title: Ontology pilot screen: incumbent vs evidence-ontology memory, symbolic, and verifier-commit on card 010's 31 eval tasks
hypothesis: On card 010's 31 combined-eval sqlparse tasks (calibrated incumbent acceptance 32/62), at least one treatment arm (--reasoning memory, --reasoning symbolic, or verifier-commit) shows a per-task acceptance difference over the unchanged incumbent large enough to justify a powered follow-up. A screen at r = 2, not a test: it detects effects of roughly 23 points.

prerequisites.text: Owner decisions 2026-10-01 recorded verbatim in E3-difficulty-calibration-010.md and IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md: quarantine of the eval twins ("Quarantine dev twins (Recommended)") and r = 2 ("r=2 screen (Recommended)")

Owner approval of this card's launch: run count, cost and the verifier's generation calls (1-3 per task, 31 tasks, at most 93 calls), recorded verbatim in E3-ontology-pilot-024.md; then set status to approved

Verifier manifest generated after the launch approval: experiments/p6_pilot/repro_verifiers.py generate --out experiments/session_harness/verifiers/024 --tasks experiments/mutation_tasks/tasks.pilot024-eval.json --model claude-sonnet-5 --oci-image localhost/reticle-p6-task:py313-v1 --spend-cap-usd <approved cap> (pre-edit runs in podman, network none; at most 93 calls), committed; then re-plan, since the verifier-commit hashes planned before it are provisional (manifest_sha256_lf null)

arms.name: incumbent
arms.note: Card 010's incumbent arm unchanged (cards/010.json and cards/010-stage2a.json): runner v8, claude-cli, claude-sonnet-5 pinned by full ID, pressure-recent-v3, reticle-tools-v3, OCI image 8b74015e5079 (podman), repeat guard off, no treatment, CLI 2.1.286 (the private copy, auto-update off). Its planned hash per task equals the hash card 010 or 010-stage2a recorded for that task (check_pilot_hashes_024.py).

arms.name: memory
arms.note: The incumbent plus --reasoning memory: the evidence ontology's reasoning_state, reasoning_update and assess_check tools over this run's own session journal; no inference rules.

arms.name: symbolic
arms.note: The incumbent plus --reasoning symbolic: the memory arm's tools plus the ontology's inference rules (consequences conditional on the model's assertions), reported only when the model asks.

arms.name: verifier-commit
arms.note: Card 021's verifier-commit treatment on card 010's incumbent: check() over the task's frozen reproduction test (counts only, at most 3 calls per run), run through the run's OCI backend; and the commitment nudge at half the response budget with the commit_hypothesis and record_observation tools. Unlike card 021 it runs on local OCI (network none, workspace-only mount), not the cloud trusted-local backend, and without --cli-reply-recovery, so the treatment is its only difference from the incumbent. The manifest's sha256 is a hash input, so this arm's hashes exist only after repro_verifiers.py generate writes experiments/session_harness/verifiers/024/manifest.json (a launch prerequisite; 1-3 model calls per task).

eval.note: Card 010's combined eval split (stage 1's 12 then stage 2a's 19), registry role eval-010-combined. The task file copies each task unchanged from the file card 010 calibrated it in (build_pilot_eval_tasks.py --check). No quarantined-eval-twin, dev, evolution or boltons task is in it.

campaign.note: 248 runs (31 tasks x 2 rollouts x 4 arms) x 24 attempts = 5952 planned, capped at 248 x 28 = 6944 (card 010's 28 per run: room for retried runs). CLI on the subscription: no monetary cap, billing recorded as unknown. List-price estimate from card 010's calibration runs of these 31 tasks: $79.71 over 62 runs = $1.286 a run, so about $319 for 248 runs, plus the verifier generation (not in this cap; see the markdown card).

stop_rules.repeat_rule: As card 007: the repeat guard is off; repeat flags are derived from the journals afterwards.
manual: Evaluator leakage, evidence loss, or authority escape stops the campaign (trajectory review).
A model_pin_violation or a CLI version other than 2.1.286 stops the campaign as a corrupted protocol.
A run ended by a usage limit, an adapter failure or a machine sleep is voided (renamed *.void-<reason>) and rerun, as in cards 010 and 018; it is not an outcome.
No arm, lesson or evolution step reads a task whose registry role is quarantined-eval-twin, dev, an evolution role or a boltons role (owner, 2026-10-01).
Do not change a treatment's text or parameters during the card; do not regenerate, edit or drop a frozen reproduction test after generation; a verifier unavailable for a task stays unavailable.
The campaign stops at the run cap or the attempt cap; an extension needs a new approval.

decision_rule: A screen, written before data (E3-ontology-pilot-024.md, Decision rule). For each treatment arm T over the 31 tasks: d(T) = mean over tasks of (T's accepted runs/2 - incumbent's accepted runs/2); wins(T) / losses(T) = tasks where T's per-task rate is higher / lower than the incumbent's. Follow-up justified for T when d(T) >= +0.10 (about +6 accepted runs of 62) and wins(T) > losses(T). Possible harm when d(T) <= -0.10 (recorded, no follow-up). Otherwise no follow-up for T on this evidence, reported as uncertain, not negative. If several arms qualify, the powered follow-up takes the largest d(T); a tie goes to the arm with fewer model calls per run (generation included). Tool use, check() calls, tokens and cost are reported, not deciding. No significance claim.
